## Appearance

Superintendent Bell is characterized by his gray whiskers and spectacles. His appearance is noted to be identical to how he looks during Sunday school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

## History

When Superintendent Bell visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) during her seven weeks of bed rest following a broken ankle, he shared his own childhood experience of breaking an ankle with her. His visit was part of a larger wave of support from schoolmates, friends, and neighbors who came to comfort [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) while she recovered.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--superintendent-bell.md)

Superintendent Bell maintains a friendly acquaintance with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) as part of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) breaks her ankle during a game of dares and is confined to seven weeks of bed rest, Superintendent Bell is among the neighbors and friends who come to visit and offer her comfort.
